name: Kinetic Viable-Region High-Resolution Refinement
contextPolicy: reuse every accepted CP148/CP149 same-TL Stage-A context containing exactly one Kinetic main weapon and one non-Kinetic opponent; preserve both side assignments, all five resource environments, all ten strata, and all opponent families available at each TL
refinementPolicy: use accepted CP149 main effects, pairwise interactions, role response and identity-stress evidence to resolve only the local Kinetic dimensions that materially change combat outcomes at each TL; fully cross the declared TL-specific levels rather than returning to one-factor tweaks

1.reason: DAM dominates; ACC and extended-band matter; standard-range +1 crosses the TL1 Energy standard-range identity ceiling

2.reason: DAM, ACC, both range dimensions and APEN all showed material leverage; levels stop at contemporary Energy ACC/range

3.reason: DAM and ACC dominate; range is retained because CP149 showed strong DAM-by-range interaction even where axial range was modest

4.reason: CP149 identity-preserving +2 DAM candidates remained weak; add +3 DAM and resolve ACC/range up to but not beyond Energy ceilings

5.reason: DAM and standard range are especially strong; ACC, extended range and APEN remain secondary but material and interact with DAM

6.reason: CP149 found only DAM materially changes TL6; ACC already equals Energy and range/APEN were flat

7.reason: DAM dominates while APEN retains small Armor-role leverage; ACC already equals Energy and range is flat

8.reason: CP149 +2 DAM plus identity-preserving range remained near 40 percent overall; expand DAM headroom while resolving the real TL8 range breakpoint and small APEN role effect

9.reason: DAM dominates and APEN has small role leverage; ACC already equals Energy and range is flat

smokeContextPolicy: reuse CP149 representative smoke contexts: per TL, all Energy/R1 central strata plus GP/R4 tight strata and Swarmer/R4 tight strata where available; one side assignment per physical smoke context
identityPolicy: CP150 candidates may equal but may not exceed contemporary Energy accuracy, standard range or maximum range; equality is explicitly flagged as an identity-boundary touch for later selection
analysisPolicy: report candidate/TL, opponent, stratum, resource, Armor-role, TP/delivery/endurance, parameter-marginal, pairwise-grid and combat-Pareto surfaces; preserve role-conditioned specialization and do not optimize a single global win-rate metric
interpretationBoundary: CP150 resolves the Kinetic viable region identified by CP149. It does not modify the source numerical matrix and it does not automatically select or promote a Kinetic ladder. The resulting identity-preserving Pareto and role surfaces are evidence for a subsequent bounded ladder selection/whole-combat confirmation step.
